title: Opposites attract
objectives: discuss relationship dynamics and personality traits
explore advanced C1 vocabulary for describing interpersonal relationships
analyze whether contrasting personalities complement each other

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce the topic of attraction between contrasting personality types and establish lesson goals.
Do you believe that opposites attract, or do birds of a feather flock together?
Ask CCQs: If two traits are complementary, do they fight each other or complete each other?
